title: The Naturalist in Nicaragua
author: Thomas Belt
description: "The Naturalist in Nicaragua" by Thomas Belt is a scientific narrative written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: The book recounts Belt's observations and experiences while living and traveling in Nicaragua, particularly around the gold mines of Chontales.

authorInfo.bio: Thomas Belt (1832–1878) wrote The Naturalist in Nicaragua. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
